paragraphs: Ben is Tom's classmate. They walk home from school. Today he comes to Tom's house. His brother comes too. The child is five. They sit at the kitchen table. Mom has some fruit for them. "I have two apples and one banana," she says. Pip sits next to the table. He looks at the fruit.

"I want the banana!" says Ben's brother. "I want it too," says Ben. "No, it is mine!" says the child. Ben is not happy. His brother is sad. Tom looks at his friend. "What can we do?" asks Tom. Mom smiles and says, "Look at the banana."

Mom makes two parts. She gives one part to Ben. She gives one part to his brother. "Thank you!" say the brothers. Tom has an apple. Pip looks at the apple. He wants a part too. "Woof!" says Pip. Tom gives him a small part. Now Tom, Ben, and the child are happy.
text.summary: Ben and his small brother visit Tom. There are two apples and one banana, and both brothers want the banana.
